title: ImageryHeader
description: Sidecar (web/public/data/imagery/{region}.json) for imagery/{region}.webp, an orbital image texture for the 3D south-pole patch. The WebP is greyscale encoded as RGB; after decoding, channels may differ slightly because of lossy compression (use any one channel, or their mean). Image axes follow the x0/y0 raster convention in common.schema.json: column 0 is x_min and columns grow with +x; row 0 is y_min and rows grow with +y (so it is NOT north-up; a top-down image viewer shows it flipped vertically). Pixels are areas: pixel (col, row) spans x in [x_min + col * pixel_m, x_min + (col + 1) * pixel_m] and y in [y_min + row * pixel_m, y_min + (row + 1) * pixel_m]. validate-data checks that pixel_m * width = x_max - x_min, pixel_m * height = y_max - y_min and pixel_m >= source_pixel_m.

attribution.description: Credit line to show wherever the image is displayed (no units).

region.description: Region id (no units); equals the file name.

x_min.description: Projected x in metres of the left edge of column 0.

x_max.description: Projected x in metres of the right edge of the last column.

y_min.description: Projected y in metres of the bottom edge of row 0.

y_max.description: Projected y in metres of the top edge of the last row.

pixel_m.description: Pixel size in projected metres, the same along x and y: (x_max - x_min) / width.

width.description: Image width in pixels (columns along +x); unitless count.

height.description: Image height in pixels (rows along +y); unitless count.

row0.description: Which y edge image row 0 sits on (no units): always y_min (rows grow with +y, as in common.schema.json).

nodata.description: Always null: every pixel is valid. Source gaps are filled from neighbouring pixels before encoding, because lossy WebP cannot keep an exact nodata value.

webp_quality.description: Lossy WebP quality used (0-100, no units).

source_level.description: WMTS tile matrix level the pixels were read from (no units).

source_pixel_m.description: Pixel size in metres of the source tiles at source_level; pixel_m >= this (never upsampled).
